verdict.rationale: Docs suggest quick API-key signup ('make your first request in minutes') implying a free tier exists, and community evidence confirms a free tier, but that same evidence shows the free tier's ToS explicitly bans using responses for AI inference — the core prototyping use case highlighted throughout Brave's own AI/agent-focused documentation — forcing developers to cancel and switch to a separate paid 'AI Inference' plan to legally prototype AI use cases.
